descriere: The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. The parameter weights the unsaturated component of the quadrature axis flux function.

descriere_scurta: Q flux quadrature axis current constant unsaturated
descriere: The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. This parameter describes the interdependency of the unsaturated component of the quadrature axis current.

descriere_scurta: Q flux direct axis current constant unsaturated
descriere: The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. This parameter describes the interdependency of the unsaturated component of the direct axis current.
The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. This parameter describes the gradients of the saturated component over the quadrature axis current.
Sets the signal source for the variable current limit. The value is referred to p0640.

Displays the operating hours for the corresponding motor. The motor operating time counter continues to run when the pulses are enabled. When the pulse enable is with- drawn, the counter is held and the value saved.
Sets the service/maintenance intervals in hours for the appropriate motor. An appropriate fault is output when the operating hours set here are reached.

descriere_scurta: CU number of inputs and outputs
descriere: Displays the number of inputs and outputs
Displays the status of the digital inputs.
Displays the inverted status of the digital inputs.
Displays the status of analog inputs.

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs input voltage/current actual
descriere: Displays the actual input voltage in V when set as voltage input. Displays the actual input current in mA when set as current input and with the load resistor switched in. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs smoothing time constant
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant of the 1st-order low pass filter for the analog inputs. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs actual value in percent
descriere: Displays the currently referred input value of the analog inputs. When interconnected, the signals are referred to the reference quantities p200x and p205x. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs characteristic value x1
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog inputs. The scaling characteristic for the analog inputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate (V, mA) of the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs characteristic value y1
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog inputs. The scaling characteristic for the analog inputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (percentage) of the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs characteristic value y2
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog inputs. The scaling characteristic for the analog inputs is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (percentage) of the 2nd value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs wire breakage monitoring response threshold
descriere: Sets the response threshold for the wire breakage monitoring of the analog inputs. The unit for the parameter value depends on the set analog input type. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)
Sets the signal source for the analog outputs. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs output value currently referred
descriere: Displays the actual referred output value of the analog outputs. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs smoothing time constant
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant of the 1st-order low pass filter for the analog outputs. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs output voltage/current actual
descriere: Displays the actual output voltage or output current at the analog outputs. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)

descriere_scurta: CU analog outputs invert signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source to invert the analog output signals. Index: [0] = AO0 (T 12/13) [1] = AO1 (T 26/27)
Displays the status of analog outputs.
Sets the simulation mode for the analog inputs.

descriere_scurta: CU analog inputs simulation mode setpoint
descriere: Sets the setpoint for the input value in the simulation mode of the analog inputs. Index: [0] = AI0 (T. 3/4) [1] = AI1 (T. 10/11)
Displays what has the master control. The drive can be controlled via the BICO interconnection or from external (e.g. the commissioning software).
Copies one Command Data Set (CDS) into another. Index: [0] = Source Command Data Set [1] = Target Command Data Set [2] = Start copying procedure
Copies one Drive Data Set (DDS) into another. Index: [0] = Source Drive Data Set [1] = Target Drive Data Set [2] = Start copying procedure

descriere_scurta: Drive Data Set selection DDS bit 1
descriere: Sets the signal source to select the Drive Data Set, bit 1 (DDS, bit 1).

Sets the freely-assignable motor number for the drive data set changeover. If the same motor is driven by different drive data sets, the same motor number must also be entered in these data sets. If the motor is also switched with the drive data set, different motor numbers must be used. In this case, the data set can only be switched when the pulse inhibit is set.
Displays the status word for the drive data set changeover.
Displays the drive data set (DDS) selected via the binector input.
Sets the signal source for the command "ON/OFF (OFF1)". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 0 (STW1.0).

Sets the first signal source for the command "No coast down/coast down (OFF2)". The following signals are AND'ed: - BI: p0844 "No coast-down / coast-down (OFF2) signal source 1" - BI: p0845 "No coast-down / coast-down (OFF2) signal source 2" For the PROFIdrive profile, the result of the AND logic operation corresponds to control word 1 bit 1 (STW1.1). BI: p0844 = 0 signal or BI: p0845 = 0 signal - OFF2 (immediate pulse suppression and switch on inhibit) BI: p0844 = 1 signal and BI: p0845 = 1 signal - No OFF2 (enable is possible)

Sets the second signal source for the command "No coast down/coast down (OFF2)". The following signals are AND'ed: - BI: p0844 "No coast-down / coast-down (OFF2) signal source 1" - BI: p0845 "No coast-down / coast-down (OFF2) signal source 2" For the PROFIdrive profile, the result of the AND logic operation corresponds to control word 1 bit 1 (STW1.1). BI: p0844 = 0 signal or BI: p0845 = 0 signal - OFF2 (immediate pulse suppression and switch on inhibit) BI: p0844 = 1 signal and BI: p0845 = 1 signal - No OFF2 (enable is possible)

descriere_scurta: No Quick Stop / Quick Stop (OFF3) signal source 1
descriere: Sets the first signal source for the command "No quick stop/quick stop (OFF3)". The following signals are AND'ed: - BI: p0848 "No quick stop / quick stop (OFF3) signal source 1" - BI: p0849 "No quick stop / quick stop (OFF3) signal source 2" For the PROFIdrive profile, the result of the AND logic operation corresponds to control word 1 bit 2 (STW1.2). BI: p0848 = 0 signal or BI: p0849 = 0 signal - OFF3 (braking along the OFF3 ramp (p1135), then pulse suppression and switch on inhibit) BI: p0848 = 1 signal and BI: p0849 = 1 signal - No OFF3 (enable is possible)

descriere_scurta: No Quick Stop / Quick Stop (OFF3) signal source 2
descriere: Sets the second signal source for the command "No quick stop/quick stop (OFF3)". The following signals are AND'ed: - BI: p0848 "No quick stop / quick stop (OFF3) signal source 1" - BI: p0849 "No quick stop / quick stop (OFF3) signal source 2" For the PROFIdrive profile, the result of the AND logic operation corresponds to control word 1 bit 2 (STW1.2). BI: p0848 = 0 signal or BI: p0849 = 0 signal - OFF3 (braking along the OFF3 ramp (p1135), then pulse suppression and switch on inhibit) BI: p0848 = 1 signal and BI: p0849 = 1 signal - No OFF3 (enable is possible)

Sets the signal source for the command "enable operation/inhibit operation". For the PROFIdrive profile, this command corresponds to control word 1 bit 3 (STW1.3). BI: p0852 = 0 signal Inhibit operation (suppress pulses). BI: p0852 = 1 signal Enable operation (pulses can be enabled).
Sets the signal source for the command "unconditionally open holding brake".
Sets the signal source for the command "enable speed controller" (r0898.12). 0 signal: Set the I component and speed controller output to zero. 1 signal: Enable speed controller.
Sets the signal source for the command "unconditionally close holding brake".
Sets the signal source for the feedback signal from the line contactor.

Sets the monitoring time of the line contactor. This time starts each time that the line contactor switches (r0863.1). If a feedback signal is not received from the line contactor within the time, a message is output.
Displays the status and control words of the drive coupling.
Displays the numbers of faults that have occurred.
Lists the fault codes stored in the drive unit. The indices can only be accessed with a valid fault code.
Displays the system runtime in milliseconds when the fault occurred.

Displays the device identification. Index: [0] = Company (Siemens = 42) [1] = Device type [2] = Firmware version [3] = Firmware date (year) [4] = Firmware date (day/month) [5] = Number of drive objects [6] = Firmware patch/hot fix
Displays the parameters that exist for this drive.
Displays those parameters with a value other than the factory setting for this drive.
Displays those parameters with a value other than the factory setting for this drive.
Displays those parameters with a value other than the factory setting for this drive.

Sets the source for the speed setpoint. For single-digit values, the following applies: The value specifies the main setpoint. For double-digit values, the following applies: The left-hand digit specifies the supplementary setpoint, the right-hand digit the main setpoint.

Sets the signal source for selecting the fixed speed setpoint.
Sets the signal source for selecting the fixed speed setpoint.
Displays the status when selecting the fixed speed setpoints.
Sets the configuration for the motorized potentiometer.

Sets the signal source to continuously lower the setpoint for the motorized potentiometer. The setpoint change (CO: r1050) depends on the set ramp-down time (p1048) and the duration of the signal that is present (BI: p1036).
Sets the maximum speed/velocity for the motorized potentiometer.
Sets the minimum speed/velocity for the motorized potentiometer.
Sets the signal source to invert the minimum speed/velocity or the maximum speed/velocity for the motorized potentiometer.
Sets the starting value for the motorized potentiometer. This starting value becomes effective after the drive has been powered up.

Sets the signal source to change over from manual to automatic when using a motorized potentiometer. In the manual mode, the setpoint is changed using two signals - raise and lower. In the automatic mode, the set- point must be interconnected via a connector input.
Sets the signal source for the setpoint of the motorized potentiometer in the automatic mode.
Sets the signal source for the setting value for the motorized potentiometer.

Sets the ramp-up time for the internal ramp-function generator for the motorized potentiometer. The setpoint is changed from zero up to the speed/velocity limit (p1082) within this time (if no initial rounding-off has been activated).

Sets the ramp-down time for the internal ramp-function generator for the motorized potentiometer. The setpoint is changed from the speed/velocity limit (p1082) to zero within this time (if no initial rounding-off has been activated).

descriere_scurta: Speed limit RFG positive direction of rotation
descriere: Sets the signal source for the speed limit of the positive direction on the ramp-function generator input.

descriere_scurta: Speed limit RFG negative direction of rotation

descriere_scurta: Speed limit in negative direction of rotation
